description: Sample organization rules for the Architecture Review Agent. These rules are added via the agent's add_org_rule tool and persisted in AgentCore Memory. This file serves as a reference for bulk-loading rules.

rules.rule_text: All Lambda functions must use arm64 architecture for cost optimization
All S3 buckets must have lifecycle policies configured to transition objects to Glacier after 90 days
All DynamoDB tables must use on-demand billing mode unless explicitly justified
All Lambda functions must have a timeout of 30 seconds or less for API-facing workloads
All RDS instances must use Multi-AZ deployment in production
All SQS queues must have a dead letter queue configured with maxReceiveCount of 3
All resources must have a Name tag and an Environment tag
All Lambda functions must use X-Ray tracing in Active mode
IAM roles must not use AWS managed policy AdministratorAccess
All API Gateway stages must have access logging enabled to CloudWatch
